label: SYNTHETIC-DATA EXPERIMENT: metrics reflect patterns deliberately embedded by the synthetic generator. They are not evidence of real customer behavior or of real-world recommendation effectiveness.
experiment: Phase 3 sequential recommendation (SASRec + ablations) vs classical baselines

sasrec.window: same model as next-event, next-item scores rank the window set

statistical_design.within_seed: paired percentile bootstrap, n_boot=1000: customer clusters (next-event), customer-task cases (window); variation inside one synthetic dataset
statistical_design.across_seed: each seed's test value or paired difference = one observation; mean, sample SD, Student-t 95% interval over seeds, per profile; never pooled with within-seed CIs
statistical_design.not_covered: SASRec initialization variation (one training seed, 1, everywhere), other profiles, sizes, windows, generator versions, any real population

protocol_notes: SASRec window scores are next-item predictions from history before the window start; the window target is a set of items, which is not SASRec's training objective.
Within/cross-session strata use the evaluator's label only; no model receives it.
Ablations reuse the Full configuration (trial 21): they measure component contributions under one controlled configuration, not each architecture's independently tuned best.
